question: Has the collective discussed Diginex's path to profitability given the M&A spend?

beats.line: The collective hasn't discussed this much lately, so this view draws on outside sources.
beats.headline: OUTSIDE SOURCES
beats.action: A halftone paper noticeboard drops onto open ground, mostly bare, and a cream chip settles at its corner.
beats.delivery: [presenting to camera] The collective hasn't discussed this much lately, so this view draws on outside sources.

beats.line: Diginex faces a classic deal problem. Near-term margin compression, then operating leverage as the platform scales.
beats.headline: M&A MATH
beats.action: The previous chip slides off the top edge as a pinned paper noticeboard sprouts a paper balance scale; a cream ribbon already runs between them as one pan dips.
beats.delivery: Diginex faces a classic deal problem. Near-term margin compression, then operating leverage as the platform scales.

beats.line: The company is in active integration mode across four acquisitions.
beats.headline: 4 ACQUISITIONS
beats.action: The previous chip flips away as the balance scale flattens into a paper ledger sheet; four torn paper squares slide onto it and lock in a row.
beats.delivery: The company is in active integration mode across four acquisitions.

beats.line: Admin costs climbed three point four million to eight point one million, with two point two million from deal work.
beats.headline: $8.1M G&A
beats.action: The previous chip is covered as a paper bar grows upward from the ledger sheet; a coin-sized cream tag reading '$2.2M' sits beside the orange string, a short black line pointing at it.
beats.delivery: [excited] Admin costs climbed three point four million to eight point one million, with two point two million from deal work.

beats.line: Profitability needs revenue growing thirty to fifty percent while admin costs stay flat.
beats.headline: +30-50% YOY
beats.action: The previous chip flips down as the calendar page folds into a paper bar chart; bars step upward while a flat paper strip lies unmoving beneath them.
beats.delivery: [fast-paced] Profitability needs revenue growing thirty to fifty percent while admin costs stay flat.

beats.line: Cross-sell has to work. Without it, you get two siloed businesses with duplicate overhead.
beats.headline: VALUE TRAP
beats.action: The previous chip slides off as two paper boxes split apart beside the bar chart; a paper hand pushes at the gap and they refuse to meet.
beats.delivery: Cross-sell has to work. Without it, you get two siloed businesses with duplicate overhead.

beats.line: Diginex has signalled focus on Brazil's seventy-seven billion dollar sustainability market.
beats.headline: $77B MARKET
beats.action: The previous chip is covered as the two boxes unfold into a paper map; the green arrow already runs from the bar chart and lands on it. A coin-sized cream tag reading '$77B' sits beside the arrow, a short black line pointing at it.
beats.delivery: Diginex has signalled focus on Brazil's seventy-seven billion dollar sustainability market.

beats.line: The next two to three earnings reports must show revenue accelerating and admin costs decelerating.
beats.headline: NEXT 2-3 REPORTS
beats.action: The previous chip flips away as the paper map tears into three paper earnings sheets, which pin themselves onto a returning noticeboard.
beats.delivery: The next two to three earnings reports must show revenue accelerating and admin costs decelerating.

beats.line: Until then, profitability remains a narrative, not a fact.
beats.headline: NOT YET A FACT
beats.action: The previous chip slides off as the earnings sheets settle back into the noticeboard; a rubber stamp presses one blank sheet and lifts, leaving it unmarked.
beats.delivery: Until then, profitability remains a narrative, not a fact.

raw.line: Resulticks, at one point five billion, is the largest. That integration tax likely runs into twenty twenty-seven.
raw.headline: INTO 2027
raw.action: The previous chip slides off as the orange string pulls a paper calendar page across to the ledger sheet, and the page holds there.
raw.delivery: Resulticks, at one point five billion, is the largest, and that integration tax likely runs into twenty twenty-seven.
